stories.title: Hybrid wind-solar-battery plants can power Kazakhstan’s demand growth
stories.description: Ember analysis finds that hybrid wind, solar and battery plants could supply electricity at an average cost of $56/MWh in Kazakhstan, compared with $70–170/MWh for new coal, while meeting up to 90% of typical demand.

stories.title: Key takeaways from All Energy Australia 2026
stories.description: The outlook for Australia’s renewable energy transition appears positive with supportive government policies and renewable energy targets, a surge in battery installations, and a strong pipeline of grid-scale solar and storage projects helping to fuel confidence.

stories.title: How “reverse game theory” could keep AI agents in check
stories.description: A new approach known as “reverse game theory” aims to create incentives for powerful AI models that make following the rules the most rational choice.

stories.title: Raising the quality of insights in agentic analytics
stories.description: In just a few years, generative AI has changed the face of enterprise analytics, notably by making analytics accessible to users across the organization. Agentic AI promises to do even more, by automating entire workflows and taking actions based on agent insights.

stories.title: Trajectory raises $45M to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts
stories.description: The one-year-old startup is now valued at $300 million.

stories.title: Yvonne Bajela is bringing $17M in fresh capital to Europe’s startup scene
stories.description: Evertrue Capital announces $17M debut fund to back early stage AI and fintech.

stories.title: 'Quiet quitting' could be hitting the economy - here's why
stories.description: Britons have become less engaged with the jobs they do and are less willing to put in extra effort, a report has found.

stories.title: Trump to remove Rwanda and South Africa from US trade deal
stories.description: The move comes barely a week after Rwanda's defence ministry was hit with sanctions by the US Treasury.

stories.title: Ax-Prover: A Deep Reasoning Agentic Framework for Theorem Proving in Mathematics and Quantum Physics
stories.description: arXiv:2510.12787v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present Ax-Prover, a multi-agent system for automated theorem proving in Lean that can solve problems across diverse scientific domains and operate either autonomously or collaboratively with human experts.

stories.title: Physics-Audited Agentic Discovery in Scientific Machine Learning
stories.description: arXiv:2607.07379v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Agentic discovery can yield mechanics surrogates with low validation error that nonetheless violate physical requirements. We present Physics-Audited Agentic SciML (PA-SciML), a framework combining large language model agents with physics auditing.

stories.title: Solar PV cuts Spain’s electricity costs by €17.02 billion over 18 months
stories.description: A study by Spanish solar association UNEF estimates that solar PV generation reduced Spain’s wholesale electricity costs by €17.02 billion ($19.03 billion) between January 2025 and June 2026. Without solar generation, average daily market prices would have been 86% higher, according to the analysis.

stories.title: Scientists reverse liver cell aging and cut Alzheimer’s-linked protein in half
stories.description: A surprising discovery suggests that rejuvenating the liver could help protect against Alzheimer’s disease and heart disease. USC researchers found that an experimental drug restored aging liver cells in rats, cutting levels of an Alzheimer’s-linked protein in half and bringing bad cholesterol down to youthful levels.
